column1: # kwatch config metadata v1
resyncSeconds|Performance|Periodic safety resync interval in seconds; zero keeps event-driven mode, otherwise at least 30.|active|
namespaces|Scope|Comma-separated namespaces to watch; leave empty to watch every namespace.|active|
namespaceSelector|Scope|Pro only. Kubernetes label selector used to choose namespaces.|active|
reasons|Scope|Pro only. Comma-separated event reasons to allow or exclude with a leading !.|active|
severityByOwnerKind|Alerts|Pro only. JSON map overriding severity by workload owner kind.|active|
severityByReason|Alerts|Pro only. JSON map overriding severity by detected reason.|active|
heartbeatMonitor.enabled|Monitors|Pro only. Send a periodic external dead-man heartbeat.|active|
heartbeatMonitor.interval|Monitors|Pro only. Seconds between heartbeat notifications.|active|
heartbeatMonitor.url|Security|Pro only. External dead-man heartbeat URL; stored only through a mounted Secret.|secret|
activeProbeMonitor.enabled|Monitors|Pro only. Run explicitly configured application probes.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.intervalSeconds|Monitors|Pro only. Seconds between active probe rounds.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.timeoutSeconds|Monitors|Pro only. Timeout for each active probe.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.failureThreshold|Monitors|Pro only. Consecutive probe failures before alerting.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.autoServices|Monitors|Pro only. Probe discoverable Service ports automatically; opt in to avoid unexpected traffic.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.excludeNamespaces|Monitors|Pro only. Namespaces automatic Service probing skips, for default-deny ingress that does not admit kwatch.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.autoDependencies|Monitors|Pro only. Probe the endpoints outside the cluster that pod environments name, over TCP; a refused dependency explains its callers.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.http|Monitors|Pro only. JSON array of HTTP probe targets with optional paths, headers, and latency limits.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.tcp|Monitors|Pro only. JSON array of TCP probe targets.|active|
activeProbeMonitor.dns|Monitors|Pro only. JSON array of DNS probe targets.|active|
upgrader.disableUpdateCheck|Operations|Disable the update notification.|active|
license.key|Operations|kwatch Pro license key; reference it as ${KWATCH_LICENSE_KEY}. The KWATCH_LICENSE_KEY variable wins over this setting. Empty runs the Community edition.|active|

clusterCheckins|Compatibility|Removed: kwatch no longer sends cluster check-ins. Accepted and ignored with a deprecation notice; use heartbeatMonitor (Pro) to learn when kwatch stops.|deprecated|heartbeatMonitor
telemetry.enabled|Operations|Send the weekly adoption heartbeat.|active|
maintenance.enabled|Operations|Pro only. Honor maintenance annotations while preserving cluster-level alerts.|active|
maintenance.annotation|Operations|Pro only. Annotation that marks deliberate maintenance on a resource.|active|
maintenance.untilAnnotation|Operations|Pro only. Optional annotation containing the maintenance expiry timestamp.|active|
app.clusterName|Operations|Cluster name shown in notifications.|active|
app.proxyURL|Operations|Optional proxy for outbound provider requests.|active|
app.disableStartupMessage|Operations|Disable the startup notification.|active|
app.logFormatter|Operations|Log output format: text or json.|active|
app.insecureSkipTLSVerify|Security|Skip TLS verification for outbound providers; strongly discouraged.|active|
app.caBundlePath|Security|Path to a mounted PEM bundle for outbound provider TLS.|active|

app.hideProHints|Operations|Remove every Pro hint from Community messages: the note that names what kwatch Pro adds, the teaser ("Pro shows which one…"), "Pro shows how to fix it." and the Pro-checks notes; the "Cause found: …" sentence stays.|active|

app.communityProvider|Operations|Alert provider the Community edition keeps when several are configured; empty keeps a pager first, then chat and the rest, then email, with the name breaking a tie.|active|
healthCheck.enabled|Operations|Expose the built-in health endpoint.|active|
healthCheck.port|Operations|Port for health and optional diagnostic endpoints.|active|
healthCheck.statusEndpoint|Security|Pro only. Serve the read-only /status view (object names, no authentication) on the health port; off by default.|active|
dashboard.enabled|Operations|Serve the read-only incident dashboard (web UI and API) on a separate listener; Pro only, off by default.|active|
dashboard.port|Operations|Port for the dashboard API listener; must not equal healthCheck.port.|active|
dashboard.mode|Security|How people reach the dashboard: local (port-forward) or shared (Ingress, https only; sign-in over plain http is refused).|active|
dashboard.trustProxy|Security|Honor X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-For from the proxy that terminates TLS in front of the dashboard.|active|
dashboard.tlsCertFile|Security|Certificate file kwatch serves on the dashboard port itself (with tlsKeyFile); reloaded when it changes.|active|
dashboard.tlsKeyFile|Security|Key file for dashboard.tlsCertFile.|active|
crd.enabled|Operations|Watch KwatchConfig and supported CRD status conditions; restart kwatch when configuration changes; enabled by the interactive installer after installing the CRD.|active|
auditLog.enabled|Operations|Pro only. Write structured incident lifecycle records to the configured audit sink.|active|
auditLog.output|Operations|Pro only. Audit output: stdout or a supported output sink.|active|
templates|Operations|Pro only. JSON map of optional reason-specific message templates.|active|
runbooks|Operations|Pro only. JSON map of reason-to-runbook URLs.|active|
silences|Noise reduction|JSON array of scoped silence rules, including eventMessages substring matches for attached Kubernetes Events.|active|
ignoreContainerNames|Compatibility|Legacy container suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignorePodNames|Compatibility|Legacy pod-name suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignoreContainerMessages|Compatibility|Legacy container-message suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignoreNodeReasons|Compatibility|Legacy node-reason suppression field.|deprecated|silences
ignoreNodeMessages|Compatibility|Legacy node-message suppression field.|deprecated|silences
kubelet.insecureSkipVerify|Security|Skip kubelet serving certificate verification for direct node stats reads; only for self-signed kubelet certificates.|active|
watch.secrets|Scope|Watch Secrets (values hashed, never stored); false removes Secret RBAC and Secret-based checks report that they cannot verify.|active|
investigation.logs|Scope|Read container logs for Pro evidence (redacted, bounded); false reads no log and shows the log section as turned off.|active|
